step.template: First touch. One specific observation, one idea, one quiet question.

output.subject: the waitlist in your texts
output.body:
Hi Maya,

Noticed Harbor takes bookings by Instagram DM and runs the waitlist over text. With six instructors and classes that fill fast, that is a lot of threads doing the work of a booking system.

One idea worth stealing either way: when a spot opens, an automatic first-in-line text with a 30 minute claim window fills most cancellations without anyone touching a phone.

Is the DM booking flow something you would ever want off your plate?

Neel
Sarga Haus
